high_level_description: The image is a news article from "The Hindu" about the sighting of a rare high-altitude butterfly called the Dusted Apollo. The butterfly is prominently displayed in the center of the image, resting on some greenery that appears to be part of a natural habitat, possibly a mountainous region given the context of the article. Butterfly: The butterfly has large wings with a pattern of black and white spots, and it features a distinctive eye-like marking on its hindwings. This is characteristic of the Dusted Apollo species.
